newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Otra sees lower full-year 1996 result.
newsitem.headline: Otra sees lower full-year 1996 result.

text.p: Technical wholesaler Otra NV said on Friday it expected full-year 1996 net from ordinary operations to be substantially lower than 1995.
The firm said that its consolidated turnover in the first nine months of 1996 increased by one percent.
"For 1996 the result from ordinary operations is expected to be substantially lower than last year," the firm said.
In 1995 the result from ordinary operations was 92.4 million guilders.

In May the company said it was tempering its expectations for a rise in profits from ordinary operations in 1996, after earlier saying it would be "extremely disappointed" if no profit growth was realised.
